subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings > Privacy replace the standalone Location-derived Privacy status card and segmented Location picker with the proposed Location Sharing switch plus Access Level row?
rationale: Current main confirms the duplicate state, but the exact visible iOS Settings contract is a product/UX choice and the reporter has already claimed active work.

options.title: Wait for a narrow contributor PR
options.body: Review the contributor's focused implementation against the current source-reproducible duplicate-card behavior and scoped iOS test expectations.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer-owned UX pass
options.body: A maintainer can take over the iOS Settings contract if no contributor PR appears or if the desired control shape differs from the proposal.

options.title: Keep the current UI
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally keep both cards if the separate Privacy summary is desired despite the duplicated Location state.

recommendation.title: Wait for a narrow contributor PR
recommendation.body: Review the contributor's focused implementation against the current source-reproducible duplicate-card behavior and scoped iOS test expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS Privacy settings history and current source blame make steipete the clearest available owner for the UI contract decision.
